transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. My mind keeps going blank at the worst times. Like... I'll look at the road-closure forms, or the stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I just can't remember the steps. Things I've done for years... it just goes empty.
Aside from these memory lapses, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless lately?
Yeah... I guess so. Most mornings, I wake up and there's just this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It's like... the day is already ruined before I even put my feet on the floor.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, low feeling?

Um... a while. I think... maybe about a year and two months? It's just been a long time of this... heaviness. I don't really have any energy, and I barely eat anymore. I just... I feel guilty all the time, I guess. But yeah... over a year.
Before this started about a year ago, had you ever experienced another period in your life when you felt this down or depressed?
No... I don't think so. Not like this.

I don't really know. Um... it's hard to keep track. I'm not sure which started first... it all just sort of blends together.
Outside of work, are you having any trouble managing everyday tasks at home, like paying bills, cooking meals, or taking care of yourself?

Um... I guess so. Just doing basic things... it's hard. Like bathing or getting dressed... even just getting to the door. It takes me so long. My family says I move like I'm underwater. But then... I don't know, sometimes I can't settle at all. I just end up pacing the hallway... wringing my hands.
Have you ever gotten lost or felt disoriented while driving or walking in places you know well?
No... I don't think so. I haven't gotten lost or anything.
Do you find yourself repeating the same questions or forgetting conversations that took place just a short while ago?
I don't... I don't really know. I don't think I repeat things. My family hasn't said anything about it.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you used to enjoy?

I suppose so. I used to do a lot... organize rides for the choir, garden swaps, snacks for the youth basketball games. Now... I don't know. I just sit there. Sometimes I stare at my phone for hours. I see the messages, but I just... I don't feel any push to answer anybody.
